name: GPT-OSS 20B
notes: PARAMS: 20.9B is the safetensors count; OpenAI's card says 21B. ACTIVE: 3.6B is OpenAI's published figure. KV: 24 * 8 * 64 * 2 * 2 bytes = 49,152 bytes/token = 48 KiB/token. Same sliding-window caveat as the 120B: sliding_window=128 on alternating layers means real KV at 128k context is well under the full-attention figure. Note the unusual ratio versus the 120B: fewer layers (24 vs 36) but far more active parameters relative to total (3.6B of 20.9B = 17% vs 5.1B of 117B = 4.4%). The 20b is the higher-throughput-per-byte model; the 120b is the one where expert weight streaming dominates.
